positions.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited
Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Limited
Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited
ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
The New India Assurance Company Limited
The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited
Nippon Life India Asset Management Limited

config:
asset_classes:
- equity
equity:
  market: IN
  factor: lowvol
  neutral: plain
  weighting: invvol
  tier: 2
  shortable: true
universe_filters:
- type: HistoryFilter
  params:
    min_days: 252
- type: DataIntegrityFilter
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: adv_usd
    min_value: 3000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: raw_close
    min_value: 20.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: mcap_usd
    min_value: 200000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: TradedDaysFilter
  params:
    min_share: 0.9
    lookback: 63
- type: OneClassPerIssuer
- type: ShortableFilter
  params:
    mode: passthrough
vol_normalizer:
  type: Identity
signals:
- type: CrossSectionalSignal
  weight: 1.0
  params:
    indicator:
      type: PanelCharacteristic
      params:
        panel: vol252
        sign: -1
    ranker:
      type: PercentileRank
      params:
        min_names: 40
    position_function:
      type: QuantilePortfolio
      params:
        long_pct: 0.3
        short_pct: 0.3
        weighting: equal
        dollar_neutral: true
        gross_normalize: true
        max_weight: 0.05
        cap_method: redistribute
    max_group_exposure: 0.1
    vol_estimator:
      type: EWMA2
      params:
        span: 63
    risk_weighting:
      type: InverseVol
      params:
        target_vol: 0.15
        floor: 0.08
        dollar_neutral: true
        group_neutral: false
        max_weight: 0.05
asset_allocator:
  type: Identity
model_gearing:
  type: XSVolTarget
  params:
    target_vol: 0.1
    vol_lookback: 126
    leverage_cap: 5.0
    buffer: 0.1
cost_model:
  type: EquityCosts
  params:
    market: IN
rebalance: monthly
position_smoothing: 21
smoothing_method: sma
group_level: sector
